lines: You know I can swim, right?
What's the point of going out on a boat?

choices.text: It's an excuse to spend some time alone with you.
What, are you scared of a little boat?
We can go back if you don't want to.

1: You trying to make up for something?
2: That's convenient. Now you want me to yourself?
Whatever. Let's go.
3: Don't say that unless you mean it.
I'm not in the mood for games.

lines: I could swim circles around this thing.

1: Oh, come on. You know I can swim.
Stop trying to get a rise out of me.
2: You think everything's a joke lately?
Just get on the boat.
3: Seriously? That's what you want to say right now?
Forget it. Let's just go.

1: I said I'd come, didn't I?
2: ...I didn't say I wanted to leave.
Can we just go?
3: Thanks. But if I wanted to go, I'd say so.
I'm still here, aren't I?

lines: It's actually pretty nice out here.
Still feels weird being above the water instead of in it.
You ever go swimming out this far?

choices.text: Maybe you could take me sometime.
Do you miss being a fish?

lines: You sure you could keep up with me?
...I might take you up on that.

1: Depends if you can actually keep up.
2: Why, so you can leave me hanging again?
Sorry. Forget I said that.
3: Not sure I want to make plans I can't count on.
Let's just get through today.

2: Yeah, great. More jokes.
You don't get to laugh everything off.
3: I'm not doing this.
Can we talk like normal people for once?

lines: But I guess being up here has its perks.

1: Doesn't mean I want to go back.
2: Sometimes I miss not having to think about all this.
Being a fish was simpler.
3: Yeah. I miss it.
At least I knew where I stood down there.

lines: I really wasn't planning on sticking around.
Didn't think there'd be much worth staying for.
But I guess things turned out alright.

choices.text: Maybe you just couldn't stay away from me.
I'm glad you decided to stay.

2: You really think that's funny?
I stayed for more than that.
3: I stayed because I thought this was something.
Don't make me regret it.

lines: And leave you alone with your terrible steering?

1: You think I'm leaving you to steer alone?
2: Maybe I should.
At least the ocean makes sense.
3: You keep saying I can leave.
Is that what you want?

1: Don't make me say it twice.
2: Then why's it feel like we're drifting?
Look, I want this to work.
3: ...I used to be.
I want to get back to that.

lines: Looks like we're getting pretty far from shore.
Guess we should head back soon.
Unless you've got another reason to keep me out here.

choices.text: Maybe I just don't want our date to end yet.
Actually, I was planning to leave you stranded.
We can head back whenever you're ready.

lines: Getting a little attached, are we?

2: Are you sure? Because you haven't acted like it.
Just tell me straight.
3: Don't say that to keep me here.
I need more than a line like that.

lines: Just remember I'm the one who can swim back.

1: Try not to fall in while you're laughing.
2: Not funny, Penni.
You know I've been thinking about leaving.
3: Maybe being stranded would be easier.
At least I'd know where I stood.

lines: Nah. We can stay a little longer.

1: Yeah. Maybe a few more minutes.
2: I appreciate that.
I don't always know what I'm ready for.
3: I think I need a minute.
Thanks for not pushing me.

lines: Don't go making a big deal out of this, but...
If you wanna do this again sometime...
